adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` now loops over `event.destinationCalendar` and, for each destination with a `credentialId`, calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` (packages/core/EventManager.ts). However, `CalendarManager.createEvent` ignores that `externalId` when invoking the integration and instead calls `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)` (packages/core/CalendarManager.ts). In `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent(calEventRaw, credentialId)`, the target calendar is selected via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId` (packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts). If `destinationCalendar` contains multiple entries with the same `credentialId`, `.find(...)` will always return the first match, so repeated calls for that same credentialId will insert multiple events into the first destination’s calendar and none into the later ones. This is a correctness defect directly implied by the selection logic in the diff.
